ideas.title: LocalAgri-Vision
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the winning pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying computer vision to geographic and land monitoring data, which appeals strongly to regional development and agricultural judging panels.

ideas.pitch: A localized, multi-agent student and community health support platform tailored for rural wellness queries in regional languages.
ideas.title: Bengali-Health-RAG

ideas.pitch: Poisson regression and machine learning forecasting tool for predicting campus energy consumption and micro-grid anomalies.

ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous statistical forecasting techniques seen in winning AI-incident-forecasting projects, demonstrating genuine hard engineering beyond simple wrapper applications.
